qualification.status: Native exact inverse-square fields and fallible 3D metaball modeling implemented and locally qualified, with an explicit normalized-field output migration.
owners: Hypersdf inverse-square evaluation and conservative field bounds
CSGRS modeling composition and shared sampled-field diagnostics
qualification.domain: Retained Real centers and strictly positive radii, positive iso value, nonnegative padding and requested sample-grid dimensions of at least two. All parameters are validated before empty-input success. Field construction and conservative bounds use strict predicates; extraction uses the selected policy and retains its local certainty. Numerical certainty applies to the sampled proposal, with topology and continuous-field fidelity separate.
qualification.migration: solid::metaballs and metaballs_with_diagnostics return Result. Added metaballs_with_context and metaballs_with_diagnostics_and_context. MetaBall is the native Hypersdf Metaball carrier; influence returns an exact Result without a distant cutoff or finite pole sentinel. MetaballField borrows validated sources and evaluates F=(iso-I)/(iso+I), I=sum(r^2/distance^2), continuously extended to -1 at centers. The exact zero set is preserved, but interpolation and serialized mesh coordinates intentionally change. Grid locations retain the conservative 101/100 margin and one-cell exterior border. Diagnostics now describe normalized F, negative inside. Hidden f32 extraction and the duplicated 3D sampler were removed in favor of the shared native sampler. This is a geometry/API migration, not a performance-only change.
semantic_evidence: Ten baseline regressions reproduced invalid radius/padding, unresolved radius, empty shortcuts hiding invalid parameters, resolution clamping, capacity exhaustion, distant influence truncation, a finite pole sentinel and inexact sampled vertices on 5d49530ee plus the unchanged original native work.

Independent exact influence and field values cover near/far points, r=2 at squared distance 9, poles, iso scaling and coincident sources. All radii are validated before any center shortcut; native scalar causes survive Error::source.

A sampled unit source at requested resolution 3 has independently derived coordinate magnitudes 20201/60600 and volume (2*20201/60600)^3. Its closed topology, exact diagnostics and empty-union/subtraction-to-empty composition pass.

Strict/approximate/strict queries preserve unresolved construction as typed Undecided. Selecting approximate meshing for exact decided samples still produces Certified. Successful construction after an error remains possible.

The original two-source 20^3 benchmark fixture and all three sources of the original 8^3 README fixture complete under strict policy, with closed topology, positive exact signed volume and bounds strictly inside independently justified conservative bounds. The pre-existing two-source 6^3 diagnostic fixture also passes unchanged in geometry input and resolution.

The metaballs-only feature compiles, passes its failure/diagnostic tests and strict all-target Clippy without enabling the public sdf feature. Shared SDF/TPMS, native Hypermesh, Hypersdf and FFI regression checks pass.
qualification.trials: Baseline v1 failed all ten tests. Its preparatory protocol described (iso-I)/(1+I); the final v2 protocol records the scale-invariant denominator iso+I. The unit-iso oracle is unchanged. Candidate v1 stopped before compilation because dep:hypersdf suppressed the implicit feature used by sdf; the manifest now retains hypersdf. Candidate v2 passed focused tests, five native field tests and strict all-target Clippy. Native v1 adds both full-size published workloads and final documentation, and all 19 commands pass. Every failed trial and source snapshot is retained.
qualification.resources: The shared sampler checks grid capacities and primary reservations, exposing overflow/allocation failure instead of an empty result. Each validation command has external 1800-second wall containment. Scalar expression growth, coefficient growth, native extraction allocations, total work, heap bytes and cancellation lack internal bounds; no bounded-execution or performance improvement claim is made. Peak memory and allocation counters were not measured.
limitations: The separate 2D curve::metaballs field and contour implementation still has its prior cutoff, sentinel and failure behavior. Its native owning-layer migration remains open.
Eight existing cases remain ignored: one root rendering case and seven Hypermesh external-fixture/manual scale or memory tests. Feature-configuration test counts overlap.

Examples, benchmark and fuzz consumers compile under strict all-target or fuzz Clippy. The two full-size construction fixtures run as tests, but generated images, export artifacts, benchmark timings and duration-based fuzzing were not qualified here.
Metaball constructors are not exposed by the current C/Go/Python/WASM bindings. FFI unit tests and all-target compilation pass; live binding consumers were not rerun for this Rust-only API migration.
The full workflow matrix, sanitizers, clean external package/release/MSRV validation, end-to-end provenance, continuous-field fidelity bounds and performance comparisons remain open.
The original 35 pending native files remain unchanged and unadmitted. Earlier scalar/native integration gaps and the complete properties plan remain open.
